# E0341: open record type out of place

A record bound ends with `..`, as `P: { name: str, .. }`, and an open record type is only a parameter's type. Elsewhere, name a type parameter with that bound.

- Rule: [`records.open-parameter-types`](../../reference/07-types.md#records.open-parameter-types)
- Reported at: the record bound or the open record type.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0341:1
fn name_of<P: { name: str }>(p: P) -> str { p.name }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn name_of<P: { name: str, .. }>(p: P) -> str { p.name }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0341_closed_record_bound.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0341_closed_record_bound.lt):

```text
── OPEN RECORD TYPE OUT OF PLACE ──── E0341_closed_record_bound.lt:1:15  [E0341]

A record bound ends with `..`, since one that named every field would be a type:

  1 │ fn name_of<P: { name: str }>(p: P) -> str { p.name }
    │               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

A record bound ends with `..`, as `P: { name: str, .. }`, and an open record
type is only a parameter's type. Elsewhere, name a type parameter with that
bound.

To fix it, add `..`:

  1 │ fn name_of<P: { name: str, .. }>(p: P) -> str { p.name }
    │                          ++++
```

`stilt check` on [`E0341_open_record_type_out_of_place.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0341_open_record_type_out_of_place.lt):

```text
── OPEN RECORD TYPE OUT OF PLACE ── E0341_open_record_type_out_of_place.lt:1:19  [E0341]

An open record type stands for a type the caller gives, so only a parameter can
have one; name a type parameter with the bound:

  1 │ fn count(ps: List<{ name: str, .. }>) -> i64 { ps.len() }
    │                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

A record bound ends with `..`, as `P: { name: str, .. }`, and an open record
type is only a parameter's type. Elsewhere, name a type parameter with that
bound.
```
